interactive.label: Open TTTR...
interactive.tooltip: Open a TTTR file (.ptu, .ht3, .phu, ...). Dropping one on the window does the same.

interactive.label: Copy visible
interactive.tooltip: Copy the visible rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tool.

interactive.label: First
interactive.tooltip: Jump to the first photon of the filtered selection.

interactive.label: Last
interactive.tooltip: Jump to the last full page of the filtered selection.

interactive.label: first_index
interactive.tooltip: Index of the first photon shown, counted within the filtered selection. A value past the end is moved back so that the page stays full.

interactive.label: rows_per_page
interactive.tooltip: Rows shown at once (1 to 20000). Large pages are fine; the table only draws what fits the window.
